inheritedMemberInventory.rationale: Add is `InsertItem(Count, item)` and validates nothing of its own
Contains is `items.Contains(item)`, a forward linear scan over EqualityComparer<T>.Default that stops at the first match
CopyTo is `items.CopyTo(array, index)` and then Array.Copy, whose three failures are a null destination, a negative index, and a destination too small for Count elements
GetEnumerator returns `items.GetEnumerator()` boxed as IEnumerator<T>, so the observed enumerator is List<T>.Enumerator and its version invalidation is List<T>'s
IndexOf is `items.IndexOf(item)`, ending in Array.IndexOf<T> over the same default comparer
Insert guards `index < 0 || index > Count`, which admits Count itself, and then reaches the InsertItem hook
get_Item is one `items[index]` whose bounds check is List<T>'s unsigned `(uint)index >= (uint)_size`; set_Item validates `index < 0 || index >= Count` itself and only then reaches the SetItem hook
get_Item is one `items[index]` whose bounds check is List<T>'s unsigned `(uint)index >= (uint)_size`; set_Item validates `index < 0 || index >= Count` itself and only then reaches the SetItem hook
Remove returns false without touching the collection when IndexOf finds nothing, and otherwise reaches the RemoveItem hook and returns true
RemoveAt guards `index < 0 || index >= Count` and then reaches the RemoveItem hook

The contract lives in the GRAPHICS package, which imports the framework package, so the settled cross-package cycle rule already projects Game's device-typed members into the descendant package and the framework package cannot name the type. Independently, nothing in CNA-Go can publish that service: the reference's registrar is GraphicsDeviceManager, whose CNA-Go projection is a partial native-backed facade satisfying neither IGraphicsDeviceService nor IGraphicsDeviceManager, so GetService would find nothing to store
